literal: Companion-goodness prosperity will give; action-goodness desired all will give.
translation: Having good companions brings prosperity, but the purity of one's actions will yield everything desired.
modern: நல்ல துணையை அடைந்திருப்பது ஒருவனுக்குச் செல்வத்தைத் தரும்; ஆனால் செய்யும் செயலின் தூய்மையானது அவன் விரும்பிய எல்லாவற்றையும் அவனுக்குத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the benefits of good associations with the benefits of pure actions. The phrase 'துணைநலம்' refers to having good and supportive companions, which brings material prosperity. However, 'வினைநலம்', which means the goodness or purity of one's own actions, is far more powerful. Pure actions will yield absolutely everything a person desires, showing that righteous conduct is the ultimate source of fulfillment.
